def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    painted_a=set()
    def fg(rr,cc): return out[rr][cc]==g[rr][cc] and g[rr][cc]!=bg
    for r in range(H):
        row=g[r]
        if all(v!=bg for v in row): continue  # full row exempt
        runs=[]; c=0
        while c<W:
            if row[c]!=bg:
                s=c
                while c<W and row[c]!=bg: c+=1
                runs.append((s,c-1))
            else: c+=1
        rightmost=max(c for c in range(W) if row[c]!=bg)
        blocked=False
        if rightmost>=0:
            iso=(rightmost==0 or row[rightmost-1]==bg)
            if iso and rightmost<W-1: blocked=True
        apaint=[]
        if [x for x in runs if x[1]-x[0]+1>=2] and not blocked:
            end=max(x[1] for x in runs if x[1]-x[0]+1>=2)
            if end<W-1:
                for c in range(end+1,W):
                    out[r][c]=1; apaint.append((r,c)); painted_a.add((r,c))
        for (rr,cc) in apaint:
            if rr+1<H and g[rr+1][cc]!=bg and (rr+1,cc) not in painted_a and out[rr+1][cc]==g[rr+1][cc]:
                out[rr+1][cc]=1
        if any(v!=bg for v in row):

                    if 0<r<H-1 and fg(r-1,c) and fg(r+1,c): out[r][c]=1
    return out

import math
def hull(points):
    points=sorted(set(points))
    if len(points)<=2: return points
    def cross(o,a,b): return (a[0]-o[0])*(b[1]-o[1])-(a[1]-o[1])*(b[0]-o[0])
    lo=[]
    for p in points:
        while len(lo)>=2 and cross(lo[-2],lo[-1],p)<=0: lo.pop()
        lo.append(p)
    up=[]
    for p in reversed(points):

        up.append(p)
    return lo[:-1]+up[:-1]

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    obj=[v for v in Counter(v for row in g for v in row) if v!=bg]
    obj=obj[0] if len(obj)==1 else None
    rows=[(r,[c for c,v in enumerate(g[r]) if v==obj]) for r in range(H)]
    rows=[(r,cs) for r,cs in rows if cs]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    prev=None
    for r,cs in rows:
        lo,hi=min(cs),max(cs)
        hidden = prev is not None and lo>=prev[0] and hi<=prev[1]
        if not hidden:
            for c in range(lo,hi+1):
                if g[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
        prev=(lo,hi)
    return out
